originalTitle: Fairfax picks up half of 3-year government bonds at auction
simplifiedContent: Fairfax Financial Holdings, a Canadian company, recently bought a large amount of 3-year government bonds at an auction. This purchase is likely a step towards the company's goal of buying a significant stake in IDBI Bank, a government-owned bank in India. Fairfax has made a few big bond purchases lately, which suggests it's getting ready to invest in the bank. The company's ultimate goal is to own a major part of IDBI Bank, which the government has been trying to privatize since October 2022. This matters because it shows that Fairfax is serious about investing in the bank and is taking steps to make that happen.

originalTitle: NIfty IT logs best weekly gains since Oct 2025
simplifiedContent: Here's what's happening in simple terms: Indian IT (Information Technology) stocks had a great week, with the Nifty IT index seeing its biggest gain in almost a year. This means that the value of these stocks went up a lot. The reason for this increase is that some big IT companies recently reported their earnings, and the results showed that they weren't affected as much by AI (Artificial Intelligence) as people thought. This made investors feel more confident, which led to them buying more stocks in the IT sector, causing the prices to rise. As a result, some investors who had previously bet against the sector (known as short-selling) are now covering their bets, which is also contributing to the price increase.

originalTitle: Reliance Retail's Q1 profit drops 14% YoY but revenue rises 8%
simplifiedContent: Reliance Retail, a big retailer, just reported its quarterly results. Unfortunately, its profit went down by 14% compared to the same time last year. However, its revenue (the amount of money it made from sales) actually increased by 8%. The company's investments in online shopping and technology are taking a toll on its profitability, but it's still aiming to grow its business in the long run. The company now has over 20,000 store locations, which is a significant expansion of its retail network.

originalTitle: Stocks to buy under  ₹200: Mehul Kothari of Anand Rathi recommends three shares to buy or sell
simplifiedContent: Mehul Kothari, an expert from Anand Rathi, thinks that investors should be careful right now. He believes that if the market goes above 24,400, it will be a good sign for investors. For people looking to buy stocks that cost less than ₹200, he suggests buying Suzlon Energy, IDBI, and Zee Entertainment. These are his top picks in this price range, and he has specific prices in mind for when to buy and sell them. This matters because it can help individual investors make informed decisions about where to put their money.

originalTitle: Axis Bank Q1 preview: Profit, NII to stay healthy; NIM likely to shrink due to deposit repricing, competitive funding
simplifiedContent: Axis Bank is about to release its quarterly results, and experts think the bank will make more money than before. This is because the bank is expected to earn more from the interest it charges on loans, which is called net interest income, and its overall profit will also increase. However, there's a concern that the bank's net interest margin, which is the difference between the interest it earns and the interest it pays, might decrease. This decrease might happen because the bank is facing competition and has to adjust the interest rates it offers to people who deposit money. This could affect the bank's overall financial performance.

originalTitle: ICICI Bank Q1 results preview: Net profit seen up 3.1% YoY to  ₹13,164 crore; NIMs, asset quality may remain stable
simplifiedContent: ICICI Bank is about to release its financial results for the first quarter of the year. The bank is expected to make a profit of ₹13,164 crore, which is 3.1% more than it made in the same quarter last year. The bank's lending business is expected to have grown by 18.5% compared to last year, thanks to strong demand for loans such as gold loans, corporate loans, and home loans. The bank's deposits, which are the amounts of money customers have put into their accounts, are also expected to have increased by 15.2% compared to last year. This growth in lending and deposits is a positive sign for the bank's performance and may be good news for its investors.
